mechanism: 경매를 통한 배분의 변화가 제품 판매량·가격 경로를 통해 제품·사업별 매출액의 증가로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R08369의 적용 맥락: This paper studies oil and gas mineral leases on Texas Permanent School Fund lands during 2005–2016 (the shale/fracking boom), comparing lease-level outcomes across allocation mechanisms: state-run first-price auctions versus informal landowner negotiations. The unit of observation is individual leases (≈1,274), with outcomes including upfront bonus payments, royalties and production. Institutional setting: historical Relinquishment Act and subsequent 1973 policy determined whether parcels were auctioned or negotiated; auctions run by the Texas General Land Office. Identification exploits quasi-random mechanism assignment across neighboring parcels transacting at similar times.
